speaker: hired_men
text: The bill this morning was the second Caesar. I have the rest of it now, and I did not see a sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not bring me a sum. What is the rest?

speaker: hired_men
text: It is their last. The Admiral's men are packing hampers for the country. No bill goes up tomorrow. Nobody over there will say why.

speaker: will_kemp
text: They've run.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Or been told. Either way the whole Bankside has nowhere to go of an afternoon but here.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I'd as soon they had somewhere.

speaker: hired_men
text: There is a rumour with it. The justices are warning every playhouse that one more tumult brings the Council's padlocks. I am telling it as a rumour. I did not see a paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A rumour is not a decision. One more tumult is their sentence, not ours, until somebody writes it down as ours.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I will not write the padlocks as a fact. I will write that the Rose's day was its last, if Raye has that from their own door.

speaker: hired_men
text: From their door. Hampers. No bill tomorrow. I have no receipt, and I am not inventing one.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I stood our stair, not theirs. I will not give you their afternoon in my box.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Run, or told. I have said run. John may keep the other. I am not doing a jig on it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the canvas. Did anything come back?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nothing came back. My man left it. There was no letter up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The line I sent says nothing of butter, and nothing of prisons. It was not a letter about this day.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then keep this day off your household's paper. I have a stair to lock, and a rumour is a bad thing to lock it with.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The fact is the last day. The reasons are not chosen. I will not choose one for you in a tiring-house.

speaker: hired_men
text: I have brought what I was given. I am not staying to pick a reason.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let him go. They've run, or they have not, and the hampers are packing either way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the hampers are the thing I am willing to believe, and the why can wait until I am at my own table.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Wait, then. I'd as soon they had somewhere, and I have said so, and I am for the stair.

speaker: john_heminges
text: God give you the road. The afternoon is theirs no longer, and it is not yet a law of ours.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Lock what you stood in. I stood ours. I am not standing theirs in the telling of it.

speaker: hired_men
text: Then I am gone. No bill tomorrow. That is the last thing I was given to say.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not yet a law. Good night, John. I am going home to write the fact, and not the reasons.
